detail.longDescription: 🥔 NEW: Botanists successfully grew healthy # potatoes in simulated lunar # soil by combining the regolith with organic vermicompost. Because # lunar dust lacks # organic nutrients and contains heavy metals, researchers tested various ratios of soil and compost to determine optimal # plant growth conditions, finding that a mixture with 30% compost yielded crops comparable to those grown on # Earth . 👉 https://www. popsci.com/science/moon-dirt-p otatoes/ # space # agriculture # science # botany # moon # research # biology # food # nasa # astronomy # environment # education # worms
